idea: How to prevent bad smells from drains
title: The Simple Secret to Stopping Drain Odors Before They Start
description: Foul odors coming from your drains are usually caused by two common issues: a dried-out P-trap or organic buildup inside the pipe. The P-trap beneath your fixture holds a small standing pool of water that acts as a liquid barrier against sewer gas. If a sink or shower isn't used frequently, this water evaporates, allowing gases to enter your home. To prevent odors, regularly run water down infrequently used fixtures to replenish the trap seal. For active drains, periodically clean out pop-up stoppers and flush the pipe with hot water and mild dish soap to remove grease and biofilm. Persistent odors may signal a venting issue that requires professional evaluation.
